title: Music of Changing Lines: Toward a Culturally Situated Approach to the I-Ching
reasoning: The paper focuses on using LLMs to interpret the I-Ching, a core text of Chinese spiritual, philosophical, and divinatory tradition. It evaluates how AI can serve as an interpretive intermediary for this cultural and spiritual system, specifically addressing its hermeneutics and the integration of its philosophical values into a generative music system.
